summary: The diff successfully implements REQ-1 by removing the 'Doctor Suites' title from the DoctorsPage component. The PageHero component now accepts an optional title prop, and DoctorsPage no longer passes a title value, only a subtitle. All other page elements (hero image, doctor portraits collage, CTA buttons) remain intact.

hallucinated_features.description: Modified PageHero component to make title prop optional
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only specified removing the title from DoctorsPage, not modifying the PageHero component API to support optional titles. While this is a reasonable implementation approach, it represents a component API change that was not explicitly requested.
